title: Dawnice 600kW, 1200kWh Energy Storage System Powers Adamma Hotel, Abuja (February 2026)
summary: A 600kW / 1200kWh battery system at Adamma Hotel, Abuja, built to carry the hotel through grid outages.
challenge: Nigeria's grid is unreliable in urban centres, and a hotel cannot pass outages on to guests. The site needed stable power while reducing its dependence on the national grid and on diesel.
solution: A 600kW / 1200kWh energy storage system installed at the hotel in Abuja.
result: Uninterrupted power through grid outages, with less reliance on the national grid.
